/सुझाव आमंजत्रत दकए गए थे । 2. िबदक, प्रस्ट् ता जवत संि़ोध न के संबंध में प्र ाप्त 90 आपजिर्ों /सुझावों पर दिल्ली जवकास प्र ाजधकरण द्व ारा स्ट् था जपत िांच और सुनवाई ब़ोडय द्व ारा जवचार कर जलर्ा गर्ा है और दिल्ली जवकास प्र ाजधकरण की बैठक में अनुम़ोदित भी दकए गए हैं । 3. िबदक, केंद्र सरकार ने मामले के सभी पहलुओं पर ध् र् ा नपूवयक जवचार करने के पश्चा त् दिल्ली -2021 के मास्ट्ट र प् ला न/ज़ोन -डी के पजिम: राष्ट्रपजत भवन क्षेत्र ीर् जवकास ऱ्ो िना के ि़ोन डी- पटरवहन (बस टर्मयनल / पार्किंग ) और मऩोरंिनात्मक (समीपवती खेल क्षेत्र ) [फा. सं. के-13011/6/2019-डीडी-1] उपेन्द्र कुमार जतवारी, अवर सजचव MINISTRY OF HOUSING AND URBAN AFFAIRS (DELHI DIVISION) NOTIFICATION New Delhi, the 28th October, 2020 S.O. 3848(E).—Whereas, certain modifications which the Central Government proposed to make in the Master Plan for Delhi-2021/Zonal Development Plan of Zone-D regarding the area mentioned hereunder were published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, as Public Notice vide No. S.O. 962(E) dated 04.03.2020 by the Delhi Development Authority in accordance with the provisions of Section 44 of the Delhi Development Act, 1957 (61 of 1957) inviting objections/ suggestions as required by sub-section (3) of Section 11-A of the said Act, within thirty days from the date of the said notice. 2. Whereas, 90 objections/ suggestions received with regard to the proposed modification have been considered by the Board of Enquiry and Hearing, set up by the Delhi Development Authority and also approved at the meeting of Delhi Development Authority. 3. Whereas, the Central Government have after carefully considering all aspects of the matter, decided to modify the Master Plan for Delhi-2021 / Zonal Development Plan of Zone-D. -- 2 of 3 -- [भाग II—खण्ड 3(ii)] भारत का रािपत्र : असाधारण 3 4. Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred under sub-section (2) of Section 11-A of the said Act, the Central Government hereby makes the following modification in the said Master Plan for Delhi-2021 / Zonal Development Plan of Zone-D with effect from the date of Publication of this Notification in the Gazette of India. Modification: The land use of the following area of land falling in Zone –D is changed as per description listed below: Location Area (in acres) Land use as per MPD 2021/ ZDP Zone D Land use Changed to Boundaries Plot No. 1 Located on church road near DTC Central Secretariat Bus Terminal, New Delhi 15 MPD-2021 – Transportation (Bus Terminal/ Parking) and Government (President Estate & Parliament House) Residential North: South: East: West: Church Road Rashtrapati Bhavan and North Block Part of North Block Rashtrapati Bhavan ZDP of Zone-D - Transportation (Bus Terminal/ Parking) and Recreational (Neighbourhood Play Area) [F.No. K-13011/6/2019-DD-I] UPENDRA KUMAR TIWARI, Under Secy.
